questions.stem: What is the key difference between a base and an alkali?

options.text: An alkali is a base that dissolves in water to produce OH⁻ ions
Bases are always liquids while alkalis are solids

questions.explanation: An alkali is a soluble base that produces hydroxide ions (OH⁻) when dissolved in water. All alkalis are bases, but not all bases are alkalis. Insoluble bases like copper oxide cannot produce OH⁻ ions in solution.
